text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: high 502/504 rate on api-gateway-eu-west (threshold breach). Alert window: 3m. Paging oncall team. link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/PD/12345 :rotating_light:

maria: seeing the alert, adding context — spike started ~02:11 UTC, looks like gateway to inference-pool-3 upstream timeouts. paging @raj (oncall)

raj: I'm on it, joining channel. Can someone post quick telemetry (p50/p95 errors by route)?

lucas: posting a quick snapshot from observability —
```
routes: /v1/generate  errors: 4.2% (p95 window)
upstream: inference-pool-3  502/504 spike
edge-proxy:  connections OK, no CPU pressure
logs sample:
ERROR 2026-03-17T02:11:12Z conn_id=1234 upstream=10.0.5.21 read timeout
ERROR 2026-03-17T02:11:13Z conn_id=1235 upstream=10.0.5.22 read timeout
```

carol: also seeing increased closed connections from upstream 10.0.5.0/24, SYN/ACK ok but reads timing out. No config deploys in last 30m.

maria: cc @sre-rotation — do we want to trigger fallback routing / reduce fanout?

raj: yes. Initial mitigation plan: 1) scale gateway pool by +2 instances, 2) initiate traffic split to eu-central reserve (20%), 3) enable conservative circuit-breaker for /v1/generate to limit fanout to inference-pool-3. I'll run steps and post commands.

raj: scaling gateway now: `infractl scale gateway-eu-west --add 2`

incident-bot: Deploy/scale job started by raj (job id: 01GZ7). ETA ~90s.

lucas: while scaling lands, recommend quick probe —
```
$ curl -i -s -D - https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
x-request-id: 01GZ7-L
retry-after: 0
```

raj: traffic-split command executed: `/runbook traffic-shift --from=eu-west --to=eu-central --percent=20 --sticky=false` — monitoring.

carol: seeing immediate drop in 502 rate from 4.2% -> 2.1% after split. p95 latency stable. Customers on streaming endpoints still see failures.

maria: can we temporarily disable the new fanout optimization we rolled out last week for /v1/generate? That changes request parallelism and might be exacerbating timeouts.

lucas: good call. Flipping flag: `featurectl toggle fanout-optimizer --service=api-gateway --state=off --reason="502 spike mitigation"`

incident-bot: Feature toggle request queued (id: FT-778). Rollout paused.

raj: circuit-breaker set to drop requests to inference-pool-3 after 5 consecutive upstream timeouts. Observability shows error-rate trending down.

carol: customer impact: approx 3% of requests across eu-west; biggest for streaming customers (long-lived connections). No full region outage.

maria: notify support to open banner and send proactive email to customers with high streaming usage. cc: @support-team

raj: scale job completed, gateway pool +2 up. 502s now ~0.6% and falling. traffic-shift holding at 20%.

lucas: logs show upstream node 10.0.5.21 restarted by autoscaler around 02:05 UTC and rejoined but exhibiting delayed read latencies — looks like transient kernel-level IO noise on that host.

maria: good mitigation. Next steps: 1) keep traffic-split at 20% for 15m, 2) cordon affected upstream node for deeper debug, 3) run post-incident RCA.

raj: cordoning upstream now: `infractl cordon-host 10.0.5.21 --drain` — draining connections.

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated (partial) — error rate restored below alert threshold. Keep monitoring for 30m.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll create incident ticket and assign RCA to lucas + infra. Please add any follow-ups to the ticket. :thumbsup:

lucas: adding note — possible root cause: upstream host IO flakiness after restart; investigating disk scheduler metrics + kernel messages.

carol: will follow up on whether autoscaler should avoid immediate rejoin without health warmup.

raj: handing off ongoing monitoring to next oncall (@sre-rotation). I'm available if it regresses.

sre-rotation: acknowledged, monitoring dashboard open, alert threshold temporarily tightened.

maria: incident room closed for now — reopen if >1% 502s for 10m.

incident-bot: Incident resolved by mitigation actions. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/incidents/3067894321
